name: caremate-ecosystem
description: CareMate monorepo — mobile, admin portal, shared Supabase schema

scripts.ingest:dev: cd provider-ingestion && (test -d .venv || python3.12 -m venv .venv) && .venv/bin/pip install -q -r requirements.txt && .venv/bin/uvicorn app.main:app --reload --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8090
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w caremate && npm run lint -w caremate-portal
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w caremate && npm run typecheck -w caremate-portal
scripts.test: npm run test -w caremate && npm run test -w caremate-portal
